body:
V10 authority semantics stand, but its stage placement is frozen and superseded.

The video-admission review correctly found that assigning the decoder issuance join to D0 violated the already accepted sequence: D0 is a read-only Sherlock atlas adapter with no decoder dependency, and the component ledger keeps the decoder court Held for later separate authorization.

V11 now restores the gate:
1. Every purported runtime decoder record remains draft through C1, D0, and D1.
2. D0 remains read-only and decoder-free.
3. The adapter-owned issued invocation/result plus journal join, generic-codec draft boundary, and forged-whole-receipt versus issued-receipt court move to E0.
4. E0 opens only under a separately authorized decoder/component-realization bead after upstream gates close.
5. Project-authored F0 and admitted F1 courts run before any runtime observation enters the film/recall vertical.

This changes stage ownership only. Content identity, receipt integrity, and observation authority remain separate. Exact component-ledger and video-admission re-reviews are underway.
